name: Shuttle Runs
instructions: Set two markers a fixed distance apart, commonly 10 to 20 meters. Starting at one marker, sprint to the other, touch the ground or line, and immediately sprint back.
Continue for the prescribed number of shuttles or amount of time, decelerating under control at each turn to reduce strain on the joints.
Shuttle runs combine sprinting with change-of-direction demands found in many sports. A 150 lb person will burn around 400 calories doing shuttle runs for 30 minutes.
